Container.Name: Nestview
Container.Overview: Nestview is a lightweight, self-hosted Docker visibility and health tool for homelabbers. Zero-config autodiscovery of all running containers, a health dashboard, searchable log history, per-container CPU/memory/network stats, Discord alerting, and image update awareness, all from a single container with no manual service configuration required.[br][br] - [b]Default port:[/b] 8484[br] - [b]First run:[/b] A setup wizard will guide you through creating your admin account.[br][br] - [b]Documentation:[/b] https://github.com/kylejschultz/nestview[br] - [b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/TfQ8QX3Ptr
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: docker monitoring homelab containers health dashboard

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Nestview web interface.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the Nestview database (SQLite) and configuration.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Access to the Docker socket. Required for container autodiscovery, monitoring, and container restart functionality.
